name: add-feature
description: Plan, build and verify a new feature in Dead Letter Office

feature_description.description: Detailed description of what the feature should do

steps.prompt:
Read-only investigation for '{{feature_name}}' feature in Dead Letter Office.

Feature description: {{feature_description}}

Review these files:
- /run/media/nsoroallan/Content/Programming/dead-letter-office/core.js
- /run/media/nsoroallan/Content/Programming/dead-letter-office/engine.js
- /run/media/nsoroallan/Content/Programming/dead-letter-office/app.js
- /run/media/nsoroallan/Content/Programming/dead-letter-office/index.html
- /run/media/nsoroallan/Content/Programming/dead-letter-office/.kiro/steering/*.md

Output:
1. Files that need changes
2. New requirement text to add to .kiro/specs/dead-letter-office/requirements.md
3. Implementation approach that maintains Lights on keyboard access and reduced motion support
4. Any new tests needed

Do not edit files.

Implement '{{feature_name}}' following this plan:

{{previous.output}}

Key constraints:
- Follow all steering files (.kiro/steering/*.md)
- Maintain Lights on mode keyboard access (clues as focusable buttons)
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion (disable fog, bats, flicker, shake, scare face)
- All text through esc() before DOM insertion
- Add the requirement to /run/media/nsoroallan/Content/Programming/dead-letter-office/.kiro/specs/dead-letter-office/requirements.md

Work from /run/media/nsoroallan/Content/Programming/dead-letter-office

Verify the implementation from /run/media/nsoroallan/Content/Programming/dead-letter-office:

1. Run `npm test` and fix any failures
2. Check syntax with `node --check app.js` and `node --check engine.js`
3. Verify Lights on mode still works
4. Verify reduced motion preferences are respected

Report final status in 2-3 sentences.
